audio_description:
A gloved hand twists a motorcycle throttle.
A squad of armored riders pours down a ramp from the airborne Garden.
Their motorcycles leap into the sky over the countryside.
The Galbadian assault force attacks.

context.scene_title: Galbadian motorcycle assault — armored troops deploy on motorcycles down a ramp to attack (Battle of the Gardens, Disc 2).
locations: A deployment ramp off the mobile Galbadia Garden, descending over open countryside and mountains

characters.name: (Galbadian assault troops)
characters.recognition: Helmeted, dark-armored soldiers astride military motorcycles, gripping the throttle and riding in formation down the ramp.

context.summary: A gloved hand twists a motorcycle throttle, then a squad of armored riders pours down a long ramp from the airborne Garden, their bikes leaping into the sky over the countryside as the Galbadian assault force launches its attack.
context.context_note: High confidence: Galbadian motorcycle troops deploying during the Battle of the Gardens.
